name: data-path-marker

graded_by.test: core/internal/session/handshake_test.go — TestAJumpOnALiveSocketIsRecoveredByAHandshakeThatDeclaresTheLoss: with the data socket's loss and its re-dial mocked, lost is sent only after the wait for a control-side end passes with none, and restored when the re-dial's handshake reaches live

description: The data-path marker (Tu, 2026-09-27, ruled 2026-09-29: "with mock test even"): what the core observed — the session's data path to the worker is interrupted, so input may not reach the target and output may not come back — until restored. lost is sent only once the core has decided the loss is alone, after its wait for a control-side end passes with none, so a normal end never sends a spurious lost; restored when the re-dial's handshake reaches live; input meanwhile is refused replaying, and a re-dial that fails ends the session E10, terminated / worker_lost, so a lost path is never left standing. Tu's framing was a warning that input was delivered and the target is not answering: that case is quiet_prompt's, and this frame carries the data-path fact the core can observe.
